description: Defines data structures, enums, and constants for the downlink PDSCH (Physical Downlink Shared Channel) PDU in 5G NR, including parameters for transmission types, maintenance, codewords, and the PDU itself.

classes.name: dl_pdsch_maintenance_parameters_v3
classes.description: Parameters for maintaining PDSCH downlink transmission, including pattern configurations and rate matching info.

classes.name: dl_pdsch_parameters_v4
classes.description: Additional parameters for PDSCH configuration, including pattern bitmaps and MBSFN derivation.

classes.name: dl_pdsch_codeword
classes.description: Information about a codeword in the PDSCH, including code rate, modulation order, and size.

classes.name: dl_pdsch_pdu
classes.description: Represents a downlink PDSCH Protocol Data Unit with all associated parameters, including bitmap, resource allocations, codewords, and optional context.
